guide.title: How to Use the Journal
guide.subtitle: What each column means for your year-end records

items.income: Income is recorded on the date a payment was received, not the invoice date. Partial payments appear as separate entries.
items.vat: VAT is the share of the invoice's VAT included in each payment. It is always zero if you are not a VAT payer. The net result uses income excluding VAT, as in the annual declaration.
items.expenses: Expenses are recorded on the expense date. Expenses show the deductible amount in euros: the EUR amount multiplied by the business-use percentage. When only part is deductible, the full amount is shown next to it.
items.declaration: Use the income and expense totals for your annual income declaration (GPM311) or hand the export to your accountant. InvoiceTrackr does not submit anything to VMI.
items.formats: The XLSX workbook follows the familiar journal layout and includes a monthly summary sheet. The CSV has the same columns for importing into other tools.
items.sources: Keep your invoices and expense documents. Each entry links to the record it comes from.

who.question: Who is InvoiceTrackr for?
who.answer: Lithuanian freelancers working under individuali veikla pagal pažymą: designers, developers, consultants, and other solo specialists who invoice clients and track their own income, expenses, and taxes.

free.question: Can I generate an invoice without an account?
free.answer: You can generate an invoice and download the PDF for free without an account. The logged-in app is for saved freelancer workflows: clients, invoices, reminders, payments, expenses, and exports.

taxes.question: Does it calculate my taxes?
taxes.answer: It estimates GPM, VSD, and PSD for individual activity from your received income and expenses, and keeps a tax reserve on your dashboard. It's an estimate to plan with; InvoiceTrackr doesn't file anything with VMI or Sodra.

payments.question: How do payments work?
payments.answer: Clients pay you by bank transfer. Online payments aren't supported yet, so you record full or partial payments yourself when the money arrives, and the invoice status and balance update from those records.

export.question: Can I export my data?
export.answer: Yes. Export the income and expense journal to CSV or XLSX, download the annual package, or take all your records in one archive from your account settings.

languages.question: Which languages are supported?
languages.answer: Invoices can be issued in English or Lithuanian today, switchable per document.

introduction.heading: 1. Introduction
introduction.content: InvoiceTrackr is operated by Artūras Tyškevičius, a sole trader carrying out individual activity in Lithuania, who is the data controller for the personal data described in this Privacy Policy ("we," "our," or "us"). This Privacy Policy explains what information we collect when you use InvoiceTrackr, why we collect it, who we share it with, and the rights you have.

personal_info.heading: 2.1 Personal Information
personal_info.intro: When you register for an account, we collect:

financial_info.heading: 2.2 Financial Information
financial_info.intro: To enable invoice functionality, we collect:

items.banking: Banking information (bank name, code, and account number)
items.invoice: Invoice data including amounts, dates, and payment statuses
items.expenses: Expense records and the supporting documents you upload

payment_info.heading: 2.3 Payment Information
payment_info.content: InvoiceTrackr lets you record invoice payment status and bank-transfer details you enter yourself. InvoiceTrackr does not process client payments or store payment card data.

usage_info.heading: 2.4 Usage Information
usage_info.intro: We automatically collect certain information about your device and how you interact with our service:

items.errors: Technical error reports (error message, technical trace, the type of page or request, and status code)

analytics_data.heading: 2.5 Analytics and Error Reports
analytics_data.intro: With your consent, we use PostHog to understand launch funnels and basic product usage, such as page views, sign-up steps, invoice creation, PDF downloads, email sending, client creation, and bank-account setup. We do not send invoice numbers, invoice text, client details, bank account details, email addresses, addresses, or invoice amounts as analytics event properties. To keep the service working, we also send technical error reports to PostHog. Server error reports never include the full address of the page you were on. Error reports from your browser are only sent if you accepted analytics.

how_we_use.heading: 3. How We Use Your Information
how_we_use.intro: We use the collected information for the following purposes:

items.provide: To provide, operate, and maintain our invoice tracking service
items.create: To create and manage your account
items.process: To manage account access and payment records
items.generate: To generate, store, and export invoices and freelancer finance records
items.send: To send invoice-related emails to your clients
items.display: To display your income dashboard and financial analytics
items.support: To provide customer support and respond to your inquiries
items.admin: To send administrative information and service updates
items.improve: To improve our service and develop new features
items.analyze: To analyze usage patterns and trends
items.detect: To detect and prevent fraud or unauthorized access

legal_bases.heading: 4. Legal Bases for Processing
legal_bases.intro: We process personal data only where the GDPR allows it:

items.contract: To provide the service you signed up for, including your account, invoices, clients, payments, expenses and emails (performance of a contract)
items.legal_obligation: To meet legal obligations, such as responding to lawful requests from authorities (legal obligation)
items.legitimate_interests: To keep the service secure and reliable, prevent abuse, fix errors and answer support requests (legitimate interests)
items.consent: To run optional product analytics, only after you accept analytics cookies (consent, which you can withdraw at any time)

how_we_share.heading: 5. How We Share Your Information
how_we_share.intro: We do not sell your personal information. We may share your information in the following circumstances:

service_providers.heading: 5.1 Service Providers
service_providers.intro: We share information only with service providers that help us run InvoiceTrackr, and only as much as they need:

hosting.name: DigitalOcean
hosting.description: Cloud servers that run the InvoiceTrackr application

database.name: Neon
database.description: Managed database that stores your account and business records

email.name: Resend
email.description: Sending invoice, verification and password emails, and receiving messages sent to our support address

storage.name: Cloudinary
storage.description: Storing your business logo, signatures and expense documents

analytics.name: PostHog
analytics.description: Consent-based product analytics and technical error reports (EU cloud)

google.name: Google
google.description: Sign-in with Google, only if you choose to use it

legal.heading: 5.2 Legal Requirements
legal.content: We may disclose your information if required to do so by law or in response to valid requests by public authorities (e.g., a court or government agency).

business_transfers.heading: 5.3 Business Transfers
business_transfers.content: In the event of a merger, acquisition, or sale of all or a portion of our assets, your information may be transferred as part of that transaction.

data_security.heading: 6. Data Security
data_security.intro: We implement appropriate technical and organizational security measures to protect your information against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. These measures include:

items.encryption: Encryption of data in transit using SSL/TLS

data_security.disclaimer: However, no method of transmission over the Internet or electronic storage is 100% secure. While we strive to protect your information, we cannot guarantee its absolute security.

data_retention.heading: 7. Data Retention
data_retention.content: We keep your personal information while your account is active, and you can download a copy of your data from Account Settings at any time. When you delete your account, we immediately delete your profile, business details, clients, invoices, payments, expenses, tax records and uploaded files, and sign you out on all devices. Two things remain: a security log of account actions with your personal details removed, and database backups, which are overwritten within 30 days. You remain responsible for keeping your own copies of invoices and accounting records for as long as Lithuanian law requires.

your_rights.heading: 8. Your Rights and Choices
your_rights.intro: Under the GDPR you have the following rights regarding your personal data:

access.title: Access
access.description: Request access to your personal information

deletion.title: Deletion
deletion.description: Request deletion of your personal information

portability.title: Portability
portability.description: Request a copy of your data in a structured format

objection.title: Objection
